name: typescript
description: TypeScript project: prettier + eslint + tsc + vitest (lcov coverage), diff coverage via diff-cover, plus the harness designs/integrity/memory gates.
setup: npm install -D prettier eslint typescript typescript-eslint @eslint/js vitest @vitest/coverage-v8
Optional: add a 'build' script to package.json (e.g. 'tsc -p tsconfig.json') — the full-tier build gate uses `npm run build --if-present`, so it is a no-op until you do
Optional: after `pip install diff-cover`, set gates.coverage.command in agentic.config.json to: diff-cover coverage/lcov.info --compare-branch origin/main --fail-under 80
Optional: set gates.e2e.command in agentic.config.json when you have an end-to-end suite (e.g. 'playwright test')
